About the school

Education first, always with a smile.

ADA Driving School was built on a simple idea: driving lessons should feel personal, patient and genuinely enjoyable. That's why our motto is "Education with a smile." Every student — nervous first-timers and experienced drivers adding a new licence category alike — gets the same level of care.

We love our name for a reason: ADA means "island" — and this is a school built for Cyprus, based right in İskele near Long Beach, taught by people who know its roads, its roundabouts and its rhythm.

Serving students across İskele, Long Beach and the wider Cyprus / Kıbrıs area.

Island Cyprus A love for Cyprus
